description: Anchored floating panel rendered with popover="manual" and opened via the HTML Popover API, placing it in the browser top layer — above every z-index stacking context and outside every ancestor's overflow/transform clipping. overlay.js positions it against an anchor element with placement/alignment, viewport-edge flipping and shifting, scroll/resize tracking, Escape and outside-pointerdown dismissal, and a fixed-position fallback (data-tm-overlay-fallback) where the Popover API is missing. Shared primitive behind TmPopover, TmDropdown, TmContextMenu, TmSplitButton, TmDatePicker, TmDateRangePicker, TmDateTimePicker, TmMultiSelect, TmTagPicker, TmEntityPicker, TmFilterableDropdown, TmNotificationBell, TmColorPicker, TmMultiColumnComboBox and TmQueryInput popups. When the anchor scrolls fully out of the viewport the panel is parked with visibility:hidden and reappears on the anchor's return — unless focus sits inside it, in which case the panel is dismissed ('anchor-hidden') and focus returns to the anchor.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Id of the rendered panel element. Defaults to a generated value; supply one when the anchor should reference it (e.g. via aria-controls).

parameters.name: Anchor
parameters.description: The element the panel positions itself against. When unset, overlay.js falls back to the panel's previous element sibling — the natural trigger-then-panel layout.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Preferred side of the anchor the panel opens on (Bottom, Top, Left, Right).

parameters.name: Align
parameters.description: Cross-axis alignment against the anchor (Start, Center, End).

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Gap in pixels between anchor and panel on the resolved side.

parameters.name: ViewportMargin
parameters.description: Minimum distance in pixels the panel keeps from the viewport edges.

parameters.name: Flip
parameters.description: Flip to the opposite side when the preferred side does not have enough room.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: Slide the panel along the cross axis so it stays inside the viewport.

parameters.name: MatchAnchorWidth
parameters.description: Stretch the panel to the anchor's width (dropdown/select menus). The width is written before placement is measured, so a larger stylesheet min-width still wins: alignment, shift and viewport clamping all use the rendered width.

parameters.name: ConstrainHeight
parameters.description: Cap the panel height at the room available on the resolved side (honouring a smaller CSS max-height) and let it scroll. The cap tracks the room on every placement pass in both directions — it shrinks when the anchor nears the viewport edge and regrows up to the stylesheet max-height when the room returns (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.description: Close when Escape is pressed while the panel is open; focus returns to the anchor.

parameters.name: CloseOnOutsidePointerDown
parameters.description: Close when a pointerdown lands outside both the panel and the anchor.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Controlled open state. When null the panel tracks its own internal state.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the open state should change (two-way bindable).

parameters.name: OnDismissed
parameters.description: Fires when the panel is dismissed by a user gesture rather than by the consumer: "escape", "outside" or "anchor-hidden" (the anchor scrolled fully out of the viewport while focus sat inside the panel — hiding alone would keep swallowing keystrokes, so the panel closes and focus returns to the anchor since 2.9.1). Programmatic closes do not raise it.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: ARIA role of the panel — typically menu, listbox, dialog or tooltip. A Role="dialog" panel must carry an accessible name via AriaLabelledBy (preferred when the panel renders a visible title) or AriaLabel.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name rendered as aria-label on the panel element. Required for Role="dialog" panels that do not render a visible title to reference via AriaLabelledBy (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: Accessible name rendered as aria-labelledby on the panel element. Takes precedence over AriaLabel — point it at the visible title's id; the referenced element must be present (and, for ids inside ChildContent, rendered) while the panel is open (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title of the sheet header when the panel presents as a bottom sheet. Falls back to AriaLabel and then to a localized generic "Menu", so the sheet dialog is always named. Also names the popover: when neither AriaLabel nor AriaLabelledBy is set, the popover emits this as its aria-label (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the panel presents on a narrow viewport. Popover (default) renders the anchored popover at every width — surfaces whose anchor keeps focus (typeaheads, caret menus, inline toolbars) must stay on it, because a sheet moves focus to the header and loses keystrokes. Auto follows the viewport scope: a content-height bottom sheet on mobile, the anchored popover otherwise — the default on the TmDropdown/TmPopover wrappers and the explicit opt-in of the column picker and the date/time pickers. A forced Popover/Sheet renders without measuring, so a test can render it without a DOM. Anchoring options apply to the popover only (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: TrapFocus
parameters.description: Trap Tab inside the panel and mark the background inert while it is open — the modality a Role="dialog" popup promises. The TmFocusScope IS the panel root (same top-layer popover element) and aria-modal="true" is enforced by a real trap. Escape stays with overlay.js, which restores focus to the anchor on dismissal. Popover mode only (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the panel presentation resolves from. Auto follows the viewport scope (TmLayoutScopes.Viewport cascade or the internal probe); a forced value never measures, so a test can render a mode without a DOM (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement. Desktop unless the host says otherwise (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes (the initial value is not a change). Never pair with LayoutMode — a two-way bind would pin the mode (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Panel content. Rendered only while the panel is open.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the panel element — components pass their own panel class here.
